mapper.select:
select ts.session_id, ts.revision, ts.college_dept_id, ts.talk_type, ts.talk_time, ts.talk_location, ts.talk_person, ts.talk_content, ts.create_by, ts.create_time, ts.update_by, ts.update_time, exists (select 1 from talk_session_participant p where p.session_id = ts.session_id and p.user_id = #{params.currentUserId}) as current_user_participant from talk_session ts
and ts.talk_type = #{talkType} and ts.talk_time = #{talkTime} and ts.talk_location = #{talkLocation} and ts.talk_person like concat('%', #{talkPerson}, '%') and ts.talk_content = #{talkContent}
and exists (select 1 from talk_student_record sr join talk_student st on st.student_id = sr.student_id where sr.session_id = ts.session_id and (st.student_code like concat('%', #{studentKeyword}, '%') or st.student_name like concat('%', #{studentKeyword}, '%')))
and exists (select 1 from talk_session_tag tst where tst.session_id = ts.session_id and (tst.tag_value = #{tagValue} or (json_valid(tst.tag_value) and json_contains(tst.tag_value, json_quote(#{tagValue})))))
and ts.college_dept_id = #{params.collegeDeptId}
and (ts.create_by = #{params.currentUsername} or exists (select 1 from talk_session_participant mine where mine.session_id = ts.session_id and mine.user_id = #{params.currentUserId}))
order by ts.talk_time desc, ts.session_id desc

select participants.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as teacherName, count(distinct participants.session_id) as sessionCount from ( select p.session_id, p.user_id from talk_session_participant p where p.user_id is not null union select s.session_id, u0.user_id from talk_session s join sys_user u0 on u0.user_name = s.create_by where not exists (select 1 from talk_session_participant p0 where p0.session_id = s.session_id) ) participants join talk_session ts on ts.session_id = participants.session_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = participants.user_id ts.college_dept_id = #{collegeDeptId} group by participants.user_id, u.nick_name order by sessionCount desc, participants.user_id
